title: FSI-AIxData-Challenge
summary: A notebook-based submission for the FSI AIxData Challenge 2024, a financial data science competition, using XGBoost for classification on tabular data. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) to generate synthetic data for class balancing or augmentation before training the classifier.
evidence: XGBClassifier.ipynb:565 'synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata, epochs=100)' after 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer'
